answer: Cost first: every submission locks its payment in escrow until a rotating panel grades it, and any attestation arriving from the same subnet as the submitter is taxed at the full rate, so self-attestation pays less than it costs. Then the benefit: an honest agent is graded once and paid from escrow without trusting the operator. A dune of clones behind one /24 pays that tax on every vote, and the beacon that draws the panel never lands on the same zenith twice.
